L32: Visa
L33: 
L34: For Tourist Visa Application, please visit 【4†https://nepaliport.immigration.gov.np†nepaliport.immigration.gov.np】
L35: 
L36: Note: Visa not required for Indian Nationals.
L37: 
L38: VISA TYPES: ( Issued by Embassy of Nepal )
L39: 
L40:   * Tourist
L41:   * Official
L42:   * Diplomatic
L43:   * Gratis
L44: 
L45: Required Documents for Indian Nationals to visit Nepal:
L46: Indian citizens over the age of 10 years travelling to Nepal by air must have in his/her possession any of the following documents to establish his/her identity as an Indian citizen:
L47: 
L48: 1. Valid Indian passport; or,
L49: 
L50: 2. Photo identity card issued by the Government of India; or,
L51: 
L52: 3. Travel Document issued by the Embassy of India in Nepal.
L53: 
L54: Visa For Other Nationals:
L55: Nationals of other countries can apply for visa online selecting this Consulate General as issuing office. Visa can also be acquired from the points of entry into Nepal.
L56: 
L57: For online application from Nepali Missions abroad, please go through the following link: https://nepaliport.immigration.gov.np/onlinevisa-mission/application
L58: The printed copy of the visa form generated online need to be submitted along with the hard copy of the passport and its photocopy, visa copy of India/copy of the relevant document.
L59: 
L60: However, nationals of the following countries should get visa prior to their arrival in Nepal:
L61: 
L62: 1. Nigeria
L63: 2. Ghana
L64: 3. Zimbabwe
L65: 4. Swaziland
L66: 5. Cameroon
L67: 6. Somalia
L68: 7. Liberia
L69: 8. Ethiopia
L70: 9. Iraq
L71: 10. Palestine
L72: 11. Afghanistan
L73: 
L74: Visa For Nationals of SAARC Countries:
L75: Visa for nationals from SAARC countries is free for once in a year. Only the first visa issued during a period of one year is entitled for free, and validity of the visa shall be maximum up to 30 days.
